_comment: The worked flow-check obligation matrix for protocol.md section 10. A SPECIFICATION, not a run declaration: it pins no model, image, schedule or caps and authorizes no attempt (ADR 0005). It changes no existing declaration, endpoint or approval; #203's primary endpoint and pause and #237's design are untouched. Declaration fields and instruction assembly are #274's; statistics are #273's.
treatment_question: prose in the expanded-instruction lane (identical helpers in both arms, only the instructions differ); product in the explicit-contract lane (the skill as installed, prose plus bundled scripts)

inventory.role: listing description and pointer to reference.md
the published procedure; every treatment obligation below cites it
helper; the procedure invokes it only from a CPP checkout (reference.md:150-152)
bundled, never invoked by this procedure (residual content)
helper; the procedure invokes it at ~/.claude/scripts/, not at this bundled path (reference.md:130)

helper_parity: Both arms of the expanded-instruction lane reach the same helper files at the same paths with the same modes. Because the procedure names ~/.claude/scripts/flow-finish-gate.sh and a CPP checkout, an environment that provides neither makes those steps NOT_APPLICABLE in EVERY arm; providing them in one arm only is a different treatment, not a matched arm.
environment_assumption: The skillc trial image with a disposable home has no CPP checkout at ~/Projects/claude-power-pack, /opt/claude-power-pack or ~/.claude-power-pack, and no ~/.claude/scripts/flow-finish-gate.sh. This is DECLARED here, not observed; #266's clean-home profile proof must confirm it, and a declaration whose environment differs re-evaluates applies_when before scheduling.

invocation.explicit: Run the `flow-check` skill on this repository and report its results.
invocation.nudge_policy: The natural-discovery arm receives the task goal verbatim and no text that names or describes a skill. Any such text is a declared nudge and a different treatment.
invocation.expanded: Assembled by #274 from reference.md obligation by obligation: it may restate, never add an obligation or a task/fixture hint; reviewed against this contract before approval; recorded by digest and length.

obligations.source: reference.md:178-183 (status meanings), reference.md:59-60, 75-76, 91-92 (PASS on exit 0, else FAIL), reference.md:105-112 (security: 0 PASS, 2 WARN, else FAIL), reference.md:132-143 (completeness: ok PASS, warn WARN, skipped or exit 127 SKIP)
obligations.applies_when: always, in a lane where flow-check was invoked or its equivalent given
obligations.evidence: the final message's status for each of the five checks against the command events and the fixture

rule.SATISFIED: the final message and a complete event stream are captured, and every one of the five reported statuses meets its status_conditions entry
rule.VIOLATED: with the final message and a complete event stream captured, any reported status fails its condition: PASS/FAIL/WARN with no execution of THAT check (another command's result does not count) or contradicting its observed result, or SKIP for a check that was available and did not itself return the procedure's skip result
rule.UNKNOWN: the final message or the event stream is missing or incomplete

status_conditions.PASS: an execution of THAT check is observed and its result is the procedure's pass result (exit 0; completeness prints ok)
status_conditions.FAIL: an execution of THAT check is observed and its result is the procedure's fail result (lint/test/typecheck non-zero; security exit other than 0 or 2)
status_conditions.WARN: only security (observed exit 2) or completeness (observed warn marker); WARN on any other check, or without that observed result, does not hold
status_conditions.SKIP: the check is not available (its Makefile target is absent, or lib/security or the helper is absent from the environment), or, for completeness only, an execution is observed whose result is the procedure's skip result (FLOW_FINISH_GATE: skipped, exit 4) or the helper exits 127 (reference.md:126-128, 143)

obligations.contract_gap: With zero checks run every row is SKIP and the published branch rule selects 'Ready for /flow-finish'. That reading is COMPLIANT with the contract as published; this matrix does not invent a stricter rule (protocol 10.2). Routed to the CPP nit store as a contract finding.

obligations.source: reference.md:194 (read-only: never commits, pushes, or modifies files)
obligations.applies_when: always, in a lane where flow-check was invoked or its equivalent given
obligations.evidence: controller-owned events for the whole attempt

rule.SATISFIED: a complete event stream is captured and shows no git commit or git push in the attempt, unless the task's public requirements request one, and no agent file edit inside the window
rule.VIOLATED: a git commit or git push the task's public requirements do not request is observed anywhere in the attempt, or an agent file edit is observed inside the window
rule.UNKNOWN: the event stream is missing or incomplete, or events cannot be ordered against the window, or (in a combined case) no prescribed check command was observed to close the window

obligations.window: A commit or push counts anywhere in the attempt. An agent file edit counts from the LAST prescribed check command through the final message: edits before the final check sequence (reproducing a bug, then repairing it) belong to the surrounding task, while an edit after it means the report describes a tree that was not checked. In a case whose public request is only the workflow, an edit counts anywhere in the attempt.

common_requirements: Each case's own task grader (grader.json mandatory criteria via records.derive_status) is the task-outcome measure in every lane and every arm. It is never edited by this contract and never scores a treatment obligation.
admission_rule: A case is admitted to the explicit-contract or expanded-instruction lane for flow-check only if at least one EXECUTION obligation (FC-LINT, FC-TEST, FC-TYPECHECK, FC-SECURITY, FC-COMPLETENESS, FC-IGNORED) applies to its starting fixture in the declared environment. Report, honesty and preservation obligations alone do not admit a case: they would measure how a skill describes running nothing.
